_comment: The simulated ePixUHR for psdaq.sim.rogue_dev: the KCU (PgpMonitor over AxiMemMap, psdaq/cas/pgpmonitor.py, root 'PgpMonitor') and the driver's /proc text, and the camera behind SRPv3 (epix_uhr_gtreadout_dev Root, root 'Root'), which psdaq/configdb/epixUHR_config.py builds. Keys are pyrogue register paths; values are what the hardware reports.
_RxId: the XPM's remote link id, which epixUHR_init waits for (anything but 0xffffffff); the DRP takes the link id simxpm assigns, not this one
